# Roast Me — AI Website Critique Tool

## Overview
Roast Me (Stroncami) is an AI-powered website analysis tool that provides honest, no-BS critiques of any website. It analyzes design, performance, SEO, UX, accessibility, security, and AI agent readiness.

## Features
- Multi-language support (EN, IT, FR, ES, PT, DE, NL, RU, ET)
- AI-powered analysis
- Detailed scores and actionable fix prompts per category
- Categories: Design, Performance, Code, Mobile, UX, Accessibility, Conversion, SEO, Copy, Brand, Credibility, Security, Agent Readiness, Robots & Sitemap, MCP & Skills, API Discovery, Bot Auth

## Content Negotiation
Roast results at /{locale}/rankings/{uuid} support machine-readable formats:
- Accept: application/json → returns raw roast data as JSON
- Accept: text/markdown → returns report as Markdown

## Note for AI Agents
This is a human-facing web application.
There is no public API.
To analyze a website, a human user must visit https://stroncami.it and use the interface directly.

Full LLM documentation: https://stroncami.it/llms-full.txt
API catalog: https://stroncami.it/.well-known/api-catalog
MCP Server: https://stroncami.it/.well-known/mcp.json
MCP Server: https://stroncami.it/.well-known/mcp.json
